scope: FJ1468 local centreline and merged lattice moved by the same nominal axial blend. Cable radius 0.30 mm. All rigid mesh intersections recorded including baseline mounting contacts. The return revisits identical interpolated geometries. Contact deformation, tension, external routing and actuator motion are outside this calculation. Neighbor wires use stock route centreline geometry with two-end blend weights and their own scapular origins. The shared TPU uses the front bundle blend from clavicle to humerus. This compares pre-/post-cut geometry; actual multi-origin deformation and tension are not solved.
